appliedDeletions.stem: What is the final step in the Product-of-Sums method?

appliedDeletions.stem: Which of the following is an advantage of using the Product-of-Sums method?
appliedDeletions.answer: It is easier to understand than other simplification methods

appliedDeletions.stem: What is the purpose of applying the Product-of-Sums method to the complement of an expression?
